messages:
Ellen (AE): FYI exec escalation from Meridian Data. CTO says POC blocked: SSO assertion audience mismatch, p95 spikes when mixed short/long contexts, and procurement wants a month-to-month pilot quote instead of annual commit. They want an exec bridge today.

Marco (Presales): I'll draft pilot pricing (month-to-month + convertible commit). Need baseline tokens/day and peak RPS. Procurement mentioned 80k tokens/day and 180 rps peak.

Zoe (SRE): Looking at logs: audience mismatch is IdP config; throughput spike correlates with KV cache churn when seq >1024. Can run kv-prefetch canary and a mixed-length perf test.

Priyanka (Security): They'll want SOC2 + our security questionnaire filled. If BYO-KMS requested, Legal needs a DPA addendum. Also confirm TLS ciphers and egress options.

Dom (Legal): We can fast-track a scoped DPA for pilot BYO-KMS. Need to know rotation/rotation-window and what key material leaves their control.

BridgeBot: Bridge created: https://bridges.redwood/BR-7019. Tentative 18:00 PT. Use /bridge confirm to update.

Ellen (AE): Owners: Marco=pricing; Zoe=perf + canary; Priyanka=security artifacts + questionnaire; Dom=DPA. Can someone craft one-liner for invite?

Marco (Presales): One-liner: "Run a short kv-prefetch canary for mixed-context workloads, complete SSO metadata exchange, and provide a 30-day pilot pricing proposal to close the POC."

Zoe (SRE): Starting canary: `./perf --target https://poc.meridian/redwood --concurrency 70 --seq-mix short:60,long:40 --kv-prefetch`
Tail: [2026-03-23T16:12Z] run=canary-72 p95=640ms kv_miss=21% ; [2026-03-23T16:24Z] run=canary-73 p95=320ms kv_miss=5.8% (after prefetch). CSV: https://perf.redwood/runs/canary-73.csv

Priyanka (Security): Uploaded SOC2 + KMS attestation: https://vault.redwood/artifacts/soc2-2025.pdf, https://vault.redwood/artifacts/kms-attest.pdf. Also uploaded questionnaire draft: https://vault.redwood/drafts/meridian-qna.

Dom (Legal): DPA addendum template uploaded for review: https://legal.redwood/drafts/meridian-dpa. If BYO-HSM requested, flag here and we'll loop counsel.

Ellen (AE): Scheduling bridge now. Agenda: 1) SRE shows canary results, 2) Security reviews artifacts and BYO-KMS path, 3) Presales delivers 30-day pilot quote. I'll invite Meridian CTO + procurement + our exec.

Marco (Presales): Draft pilot pricing posted: https://pricing.redwood/drafts/meridian-pilot. I'll include convertible commit T&C and an early-adopter concession.

BridgeBot: Reminder: BR-7019 starts in 20 minutes.

Ellen (AE): Post-bridge summary: CTO accepted canary numbers and SSO plan; procurement requested written pilot contract. Action items: Marco finalize pilot quote; Dom send DPA to Meridian counsel; Zoe upload full perf CSV; Priyanka finalize questionnaire. Closing loop in BR-7019 notes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
